names.name: Sak Yant Chiang Mai
names.th: สักยันต์เชียงใหม่
names.said: A booking service, by its own description, with a published lineage

text.what: The Chiang Mai operation that publishes the profile of every master it works with — teacher, temple, family line, years in the robe and out.
text.story:
Seventeen practitioners, twelve *ajarn* and five monks; thirty teacher links; twelve named temples; family lines to the third, fourth and fifth generation.

*Inference —* that is a lineage map for a living hand tradition, published by the people in it, and there is nothing else like it on this site. Every other lineage here was reconstructed by an outsider after the fact, or lost.

It describes itself as a booking service rather than a *samnak*, a master's house, and this site repeats its own description rather than upgrading it.

text_th.what: สำนักงานในเชียงใหม่ที่เผยแพร่ประวัติของครูทุกคนที่ร่วมงาน ทั้งครูผู้สอน วัด สายตระกูล และจำนวนปีทั้งในและนอกผ้าเหลือง

names.name: The Veiqia Project
names.said: Fijian women artists, taking the practice back out of the archive

text.what: The collective of Fijian women artists who researched veiqia in collections and archives and brought the practice back.
text.story: The research problem was that the practice ended around 1910 with one named practitioner. The material was in museums, in nineteenth-century accounts, and on objects. The project worked from those and from Fijian women's own reading of them.

text_th.what: กลุ่มศิลปินหญิงชาวฟิจิที่ค้นคว้า veiqia จากคอลเลกชันและหอจดหมายเหตุ แล้วนำกลับมาปฏิบัติ

names.name: wichaa.net
names.said: Where the manuscript corpus this site counts is held

text.what: The manuscript corpus and knowledge hub this site's Lanna material comes out of, and where its companion page lives.
text.story: The corpus holds thousands of pages of northern Thai manuscript material, transcribed and translated, including the yant volumes indexed at /yant. The count this site publishes — how many of those transcribed pages mention the leg tattoo — was run against it.
